body: Founder: 'double the range of gary auto attack and abilities.' ARENA_GARY_ATTACK_RANGE/Q_RANGE/W_RANGE/R_RANGE doubled (6/6/9/6 -> 12/12/18/12). Verified every call site keys off the named constants (no hardcoded literals), so doubling the #defines alone was sufficient. Full suite green (existing tests reference the constants, scaled automatically), build clean.
title: Gary: auto-attack range + all abilities doubled
